profile.headline: Software Developer, Specialist at Prudential Financial
profile.summary: Enthusiastic full stack software engineer with 4+ years of experience in building highly available applications. Experienced in Angular, React, Node.js and some Spring Boot . Clear understanding of the entire SDLC and agile methodologies. Currently training in Spring boot API development. Highly motivated to learn, grow and excel with a new team.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Front end development using Angular framework, creating custom services, components and libraries for multiple customer facing projects at Prudential.
•	Translated design personnel's ideation into concrete development frameworks for use in LINK and Pru Builder applications.
•	Contributed ideas and suggestions in scrum meetings and delivered updates on deadlines, designs and enhancements.
•	Created data flow diagrams and user flow charts to clearly demonstrate processes and user interactions for numerous applications. Documented all software development methodologies in technical manuals to be used by developers in future projects.
•	Performed regression and system-level testing to verify software quality and function prior to release.
•	Never one to shy away from challenging problems or bug fixes, which lead to being nominated for a Prudential LEAP bonus my first year.
•	Awarded the Star of the Quarter (Q4 2019)

positions.title: System Support Coordinator
positions.description:
•	First point of contact in proving networking and desktop support, through troubleshooting hardware and software issues for both Mac and Windows systems, for the 350+ users at all Sharks (SSE) locations.
•	Surpassed NHL and USA Women’s Olympic Committee’s expectations by meeting crucial deadlines overhauling the networking infrastructure at the SAP Center, creating new SSID’s for private Wi-Fi networks, creating VLAN’s to separate corporate, private and public networks, installing HP switches throughout SAP for incoming media, during the Stanley Cup Finals and Women’s Olympic Trials.
•	Assisted in managing and maintaining Sharks corporate network (AD servers, Mail Servers, SQL DB servers, and other needed servers), deploying scripts and batch files to ease network and domain administration.
•	Created and managed hundreds of Citrix virtual desktops using Citrix Studio, as well as vSphere Hypervisor software.

positions.title: Junior Consultant
positions.description:
•	Deployed 200+ workstations to a customer’s company domain (PC based workstations) using various imaging techniques (PXE, USB, DVD) in under 2 weeks at multiple location around the Bay Area to surpassing customers expected deadline.
•	Maintained Windows servers and networks (Router/Switch setup, Firewall setup, Port forwarding, VLAN configurations) for small to mid-sized customers throughout the greater Bay Area.
•	Fluent in troubleshooting Mac OSX and Windows operating systems.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science Engineering - Software Engineering Track
